title: Let’s try this again shall we! @New York City Center #mysonsaqueer #t...
transcript: Y'all, it's happening! My son's a queer is coming to New York for one weekend only this June. I love the show so, so much, and if you have been waiting for it to come to New York as long as I have, you have to get your tickets. It is only playing at June 3rd, 15th through the 15th at New York City Center. My Son's a queer is a beautiful, autobiographical show that's not really a play, not really a music. It's a more of a non binary show. It's all about Rob Madge's own childhood and reenacting Disney parades with their entire family and how much and how supportive their family was helped them to grow into the person that they are today. It's just. It's a beautiful show. It's also got this wonderful score by Robert Majan Piccolli that you can listen to right now on. On any streaming platform. It's got a cast recording. If you are a New York City Center member, tickets are already on sale. If you are not and waiting for general tickets, they go on sale on April 24th, so literally Thursday. I cannot recommend the show enough. It is exactly the kind of theater that we need right now. It is so joyous and beautifully queer, but full of so, so, so much love, which there's just not enough of right now. I am so glad that New York audiences get to see this show. I hope I get to see this show. Except that I Was planning on going to London during this time, so we'll see. We'll see what weird theater schedule I can plan up, but I cannot miss this. I'm so, so, so happy.
classificationReason: Promotional/anticipation content about an upcoming NYC City Center run ('tickets go on sale Thursday'). Creator expresses love for the show but is encouraging others to buy tickets for a future production. The show is not in the provided list.
